logic: metric temporal logic over a finite trace, three-valued
note: each formula here is the object that is evaluated, not a description of separate code. Missing evidence never becomes PASS

operators.O[a,b]: once, somewhere in the past interval
operators.phi S[a,b] psi: since: psi held somewhere in the past interval and phi has held at every instant after it. The one operator whose window is set by an event rather than by a constant

properties.benchmark_rule: a vehicle facing a stop sign must come to a complete stop before the stop line. Stated as the benchmark rule for this experiment
properties.rationale: the stop has to fall between seeing the sign and reaching the line, which is why this needs Since rather than Once. O[0,12] FULL_STOP would be satisfied by a stop made before the sign was ever seen -- at a previous junction, say -- which is not the obligation
properties.title: a stop sign seen means a full stop before the line

properties.benchmark_rule: a vehicle facing a yield sign must give way to conflicting traffic before entering the conflict region. Benchmark rule for this experiment
properties.formula: (O[0,12] YIELD_SIGN_DETECTED(self) -> !((!((FULL_STOP(self) | DECELERATION(self) | HARD_DECELERATION(self) | BRAKE_ONSET(self))) S[0,12] YIELD_SIGN_DETECTED(self))))
properties.rationale: the same shape as P1: yielding is a behaviour between seeing the sign and entering the conflict, so the window is set by the sign rather than by a constant
properties.title: a yield sign seen means yielding before conflict entry

properties.formula: F[0,1.5] (BRAKE_ONSET(self) | HARD_BRAKE(self) | HARD_DECELERATION(self) | DECELERATION(self) | STEER_ONSET(self) | SIGNIFICANT_HEADING_CHANGE(self))
properties.rationale: braking and swerving are both responses; the property is about whether the vehicle did anything, not about which of the two it chose
properties.title: a critical time-to-collision gets a response

properties.rationale: distinct from P3 on purpose: a vehicle can brake and then accelerate again, which satisfies 'responded' while still making things worse
properties.title: no acceleration into a critical conflict

properties.rationale: the one property most often UNKNOWN rather than decided, because a collision near the end of a 25 s window leaves the eight seconds after it unrecorded. That is the correct answer there, not a failure
properties.title: a collision is followed by coming to rest

properties.benchmark_rule: a solid lane line may not be crossed. Benchmark rule for this experiment; real road rules admit exceptions this does not model
properties.rationale: trivially false whenever it fires, which is the point: the trigger is the violation. Written this way so that the report carries the crossing as a located counterexample rather than as a bare count
properties.title: a solid line is not crossed

properties.rationale: in a chain the merged log must contain each impact once. Two vehicles each reporting the same contact, badly aligned, shows up as the same pair colliding twice a fraction of a second apart -- which is a reconstruction failure and is visible from the trace alone. Note what this does *not* check: whether the two impacts of a chain are in the right order. Nothing internal to a trace can say that, because a consistently wrong order is still self-consistent; order correctness is measured against ground truth in the reconstruction metrics instead
properties.title: one impact per pair on the merged timeline

properties.rationale: checks the non-action detector against the trace by a second route. The two agreeing proves little; the two disagreeing means one of them is wrong, and that is worth being able to see
properties.title: a claimed missing braking response really had no response

verdicts.FAIL: at least one instance violated it
verdicts.PASS: the property held at every triggered instance
verdicts.UNKNOWN: no instance failed, and at least one could not be decided because the interval ran outside the recording or across a gap in the evidence
verdicts.vacuous: the trigger never fired, so there was nothing to check. Reported separately and excluded from accuracy figures
